svg.title: Map of Western Europe and West Africa with the great-circle path from Hoboken in Belgium to Lac de Koba in Guinea: 4,879 km at a heading of 206 degrees, almost due south. The path crosses France, Spain, Morocco, Western Sahara and Mauritania. Two hops via the F2 layer, with the signal touching the ground once, near southern Morocco. A shaded belt over West Africa marks the tropical thunderstorm zone.
svg.text: Own calculation. Map data: Natural Earth.
